changelog:
v2.3.0 — CALL RECORDER:

⏺ Record any phone call — no root, works on Android 10+
Speaker-on mic capture (the pro-recorder method), call-state detection, auto-save on hangup
📁 Recordings library: play, share, delete — number + date + size saved with each file
⚖️ Legal reminder built in: consent laws vary by country

Updates in place over v2.2.0 — no uninstall needed.
